test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**The given sentence is divided into three segments. Select the option that has the segment with a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'no error' as your answer.**

Soumya will be speak / on 'Stress management' in / London the next week.
solution:
The erroneous part of the sentence is: **Soumya will be speak**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error in the original sentence was introduced when "**be**" was included, which is unnecessary in this context. 
 
• The verb "speak" should be in its base form "**speak**" instead of "speak" with the auxiliary verb "**will be**."
 
• "**will be**" is used in the future continuous tense. It indicates an ongoing or continuous action that will be happening at a particular point in the future.
 
• "**will + verb**" is used in the simple future tense. It indicates an action that will take place in the future without any additional duration or ongoing aspect.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

**The correct sentence should be:** *Soumya will speak on 'Stress management' in London next week.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• "**on 'Stress Management' in**" is grammatically correct as it is a preposition followed by a noun phrase.
 
• "**London the next week**" is also grammatically correct as it is a prepositional phrase indicating time and place.
